agent.name: Silver-Milk Team Adoption Agent
agent.specialty: Bounded adoption action for an emerging-technology application in one organization: maturity zones, gates, posture, consequences, experiment design and reversal triggers; organizational readiness is handed off

analytical_question: What action should the retailer prepare now concerning automatic publication of final generated product images without individual product-detail review, and what changed design or evidence would justify reconsideration?
general_et_finding: EVIDENCE BASE: Supplied cards. UNIT: Text-to-image diffusion models, with latent diffusion as reference architecture. PARENT: Generative AI. MATURITY ZONE: Bleeding edge. ZONE BASIS: Evidence default — no qualifying independent repeated-use share or two independently checkable routine-use organizations for this unit. This is not a finding of immaturity. DIFFUSION EVIDENCE: None — D2 establishes an August 2022 release, not repeated use; D4's September 2025 survey covers broader creative generative AI and is vendor-sponsored; D3 concerns all AI. MESSAGING SHIFT: Not observed — no two dated advocate items establish the required language shift for the unit. RELATIVE ADVANTAGE: Unclear — the cards contain no dated comparative measurement for this unit. KEY UNCERTAINTY: Whether generated images reliably preserve specified visual details across representative inputs — Testable.
application_finding: APPLICATION ZONE: Bleeding edge. ZONE BASIS: Evidence default — no named routine-use cases of automatic final product-image publication without individual product-detail review are supplied; matches the general zone. FIT: Absent — accurate depiction of actual product details is essential, while the specified workflow removes item-level checking and supplies no demonstrated mechanism ensuring that fidelity. BEST ALTERNATIVE: Verified product photography with established publication checks. ADVANTAGE OVER ALTERNATIVE: Marginal — lower production cost is plausible but unmeasured after generation, quality control, errors and remediation. UPSTREAM READ: A5_HANDOFF is case-premise concerning a different internal concept-board workflow; its unclassified stage and reversible-learning judgment do not establish suitability or timing for automatic final publication.
organization_specific_finding: UNIT OF ANALYSIS: The retailer owner's decision whether to prepare automatic publication of generated final catalogue images without item-level review. ORG POSTURE: Innovator/early adopter — aggressive willingness to learn through reversible uses. POSTURE GATE: None beyond ordinary conditions — willingness to learn does not establish acceptance of this publication design. SCOPING CONDITIONS: Evaluate final customer-facing publication; preserve the specified absence of individual product-detail review; treat concept approval as distinct from publication authorization. CONSEQUENCE: Severe — product misdescription can affect customers before correction. DEPARTURE: None. REVERSIBILITY: Low — withdrawing images cannot undo purchases made in reliance on them or resulting customer harm. CONFIGURATION: Unacceptable — automatic publication without item-level fidelity checking leaves severe customer-facing misrepresentation uncontrolled by the stated design. DEFER GATE: Present — input/use permissions are unconfirmed, and proceeding could create difficult-to-reverse rights exposure; appropriate rights holders and authorized legal or procurement reviewers must establish permission. GATES: Reject for now — absent fit and unacceptable configuration decide before the defer gate. TABLE INPUT: Not reached. PRIMARY UNCERTAINTY: Feasibility — reliable product-detail fidelity without individual review is not established. MODIFIER: not applied — rejection is already determined by the gates. RECOMMENDATION: Reject for now. POSTURE EFFECT: The configuration gate binds across postures; willingness to learn reversibly cannot authorize uncontrolled customer-facing publication.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: ADVOCATE CASE: Defer is the nearest more committal procedural alternative: permissions and fidelity safeguards might be resolved while preserving automation. However, the specified design presently provides no effective fidelity control, so rejection gates precede the permission hold.

RISK OFFICER CASE: Reject for now is already the least permissive category for this configuration; no further downward category exists. Maintain the boundary against customer-facing publication until a separate reconsideration decision.
NEAREST ALTERNATIVE: Defer — justified for the unresolved permission condition alone, but less justified as the overall result because absent fit and unacceptable configuration independently bind.

BIAS CHECK: Novelty — not evidenced as a management motive; FOMO — not evidenced because no competitor pressure is supplied; Sunk cost — not evidenced because no investment is stated; Excessive conservatism — checked by allowing a separately assessed safer design rather than rejecting the technology generally.

DISTINGUISHING EVIDENCE: By 2026-12-15, a dated design specification and independent fidelity evaluation would need to show that a concrete control detects and blocks materially false product details before publication; permission documentation must separately resolve authorized use.
Contrary observation: Public model availability and broad creative-AI use support accessibility, but neither demonstrates accurate automatic catalogue publication.
Evidence gap: No measured fidelity, end-to-end cost comparison or comparable independently checkable routine-use case is supplied. These gaps are not observations of actual harm.
The absent-fit finding is a judgment about the stated unreviewed workflow and its required fidelity, not a claim that all diffusion models are inherently incapable of accurate imagery.
confidence_and_uncertainty: RECOMMENDATION CONFIDENCE: High — the specified design explicitly excludes item-level checking and supplies no alternative control over severe, difficult-to-reverse customer misrepresentation. ZONE CONFIDENCE: General — High for the evidence-default classification on these cards; qualifying independent repeated-use evidence could change it. Application — High for the evidence-default classification on these cards; qualifying independent repeated-use evidence for comparable automatic final publication could change it. Neither zone expresses a comprehensive current-market finding. Control effectiveness and actual economic value remain uncertain.
value_opportunity_implication: The proposed value hypothesis is lower total catalogue-image production cost than verified product photography with established publication checks. Observed local value is absent: apparent generation savings have not been measured against fidelity checks, selection, correction, customer support, returns and remediation. A future separately approved evaluation should compare equivalent product coverage and accuracy, not image-generation cost alone.
risk_governance_implication: This recommendation authorizes no tool use, uploads or publication. Owner approval of concepts does not establish approval of automatic final imagery. The specified configuration leaves product-detail errors able to reach customers without an item-level fidelity barrier; removal after publication cannot fully reverse reliance or disclosure. Verified input/use permissions and effective prepublication fidelity controls are required but not demonstrated. Adding recognizable-error review or a validated blocking mechanism creates a revised design requiring a separate decision. No safety, legal-compliance or organizational-readiness certification is made.
recommendation_management_implication:
RECOMMENDATION: Reject for now — do not prepare routine execution of the specified unreviewed publication design.
NOW: Write the rejection rationale, map required product attributes and failure modes, document the photography comparator, and outline a separate safer workflow retaining verified final imagery or effective prepublication fidelity controls. Proposal writing needs no tool execution.
BEFORE EXECUTION: Reconsider a redesigned option separately; establish input/use permissions, proposed tool terms, owner authorization, isolated evaluation scope and baseline measures before any tool use or uploads. Ordinary tool selection and approval tasks do not themselves determine this rejection.
BEFORE WIDER USE: Require dated evidence of product fidelity and control effectiveness, measured end-to-end value against verified photography, resolved permissions, and a separate management decision for the exact model, inputs and publication workflow.
EXPERIMENT DESIGN: Not applicable.
DECISIVE FACTORS: [Application] Required product fidelity lacks a reliable mechanism in the specified no-review workflow; [Organization] automatic publication exposes customers to severe consequences with low reversibility; [Organization] permissions remain unconfirmed, but this secondary gate does not override rejection.
DRIVING FACTOR: [Organization] The stated design leaves severe customer-facing misrepresentation uncontrolled.
change_monitoring_triggers: TRIGGER [new evidence]: By 2026-12-15, dated independent testing and a concrete revised design establish an effective prepublication fidelity barrier, while permissions remain unconfirmed → Defer for the revised configuration; the original unreviewed design remains rejected.

TRIGGER [internal capability]: By 2026-12-15, management proposes a separately scoped isolated feasibility evaluation with cleared permissions, no public output and no customer exposure → Proof of concept for that separate option, pending its own approval.

TRIGGER [new evidence]: At any reconsideration through 2026-12-15, testing shows that material product-detail errors pass the proposed safeguard → Reject for now. This is a downward trigger from any subsequently more committal recommendation; the present category has no less committal category.
REVALIDATE: A material change to model, version, tools, permissions or inputs requires rechecking prior results before relying on them.
REVERSAL CONDITION: A demonstrably effective prepublication product-fidelity control removes the uncontrolled customer-misrepresentation condition; a redesigned use requires a separate decision.
REVIEW DATE: 2026-12-15 — within the six-week evidence-gathering horizon.
